title: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.17016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating model uncertainty on real-world data is challenging because each instance provides only a single observed label, leaving true conditional class probabilities unknown. To address this, we introduce ProbabilityBench, a benchmark that provides exact, instance-level class probabilities across three simulated text-based domains: peer review, covert information transfer, and credit risk. By explicitly defining the full data-generating process for each environment, we analytically compute both exact class probabilities and Bayes error. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical guarantee that rendering these cases into natural-language memos strictly preserves their underlying generative probabilities. This exactness enables direct measurement of reported probability quality via KL divergence. Across 16 evaluated models, most models on the observed cost-quality Pareto frontiers are decision models, including Jev and Perplexity Decider.

translated_title: ProbabilityBench：基于精确真值不确定性的模型评估与校准
translated_abstract: 在真实世界数据上评估模型不确定性具有挑战性，因为每个实例仅提供一个观测标签，真实的条件类别概率是未知的。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ProbabilityBench，这是一个在三个模拟的文本领域中提供精确的、实例级类别概率的基准测试，这三个领域分别是：同行评审、隐蔽信息传递和信用风险。通过为每个环境显式定义完整的数据生成过程，我们以解析方式计算出精确的类别概率和贝叶斯误差。此外，我们提供了理论保证，即将这些案例渲染为自然语言备忘录能严格保持其底层的生成概率。这种精确性使得可以通过KL散度直接测量模型报告概率的质量。在对16个模型的评估中，观测到的成本-质量帕累托前沿上的大多数模型是决策模型，包括Jev和Perplexity Decider。
tldr: ProbabilityBench通过显式定义数据生成过程，在三个模拟文本领域中提供精确的实例级真值类别概率，实现了对模型概率预测质量的直接评估，并发现成本-质量帕累托前沿上的模型多为决策模型。
